description:
Build "The Hive" dashboard — the scenario ecosystem visualization.

**Theme: Bioluminescent**
Deep ocean dark with glowing greens, teals, cyans. Scenarios rendered as organic nodes that pulse gently when active (running). Neural pathway connection lines between dependent scenarios. Completed/production-ready scenarios glow brighter. Living system aesthetic conveying Vrooli's organic, self-improving nature.

**Metrics — Available Now (dataSource: live):**
- All scenario names, display names, descriptions, tags, categories, types (Vrooli /scenarios + service.json)
- Running/stopped status with runtime duration per scenario
- Completeness scores with classification tier (early_stage through production_ready)
- Tags for semantic grouping/clustering
- Dependency graph between scenarios (from service.json dependencies.scenarios)
- Resource dependencies — which scenarios use postgres, ollama, redis, etc.
- Port allocations per running scenario
- System warnings (zombie/orphan process counts)

**Metrics — Ideal/Future (dataSource: gap):**
- Usage frequency (which scenarios get the most API requests)
- Revenue attribution per scenario
- Scenario maturity timeline (when each reached different completeness tiers)
- Active work overlay (which scenarios have in-progress swarm-manager backlog items)

**Visualization concepts:**
- Primary: Force-directed graph or hexagonal treemap — each node is a scenario, sized by importance (critical/important/standard/experimental), colored by completeness gradient
- Semantic clusters by tag (AI tools, business tools, dev tools, infrastructure)
- Glowing edges between dependent scenarios
- Resource nodes as shared hubs multiple scenarios connect to
- Nodes pulse/breathe when running, dim when stopped
- Hover/focus shows scenario details tooltip (when controls visible)
name: command-center-hive-page
title: Build The Hive dashboard — scenario ecosystem with Bioluminescent theme
